h1: The 6 Best Office Supply Organizer Carts of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Office Supply Carts: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six rolling office supply carts compared on drawers, shelves, capacity and wheels, so you can match storage to your supplies.
summary: The SYKIARIOL 8-drawer cart is our top pick for separating many small supplies. The Goovilla 3-tier with a removable drawer is the budget all-rounder, the Pipishell and YASONIC are open-shelf carts, the 4-drawer cart adds a wooden top, and the Goovilla 5-drawer is the white-finish option.
intro: Open shelves feel convenient until a cart full of loose pens, tape and cables becomes a visual mess. The real question with an office supply cart is how much of your stuff needs a closed drawer versus an open tier.

We reviewed eight carts, merged a color variant, and ranked six on the spec sheet by drawer and shelf layout, listed capacity, wheels and price bucket. Details missing from a listing are noted rather than guessed.

products.name: SYKIARIOL Rolling Storage Cart with Drawers, 8 Drawers Utility Cart, Black
products.verdict: Eight enclosed drawers for real category separation.
products.description:
The SYKIARIOL is an 8-drawer rolling cart with fully enclosed organization, priced $50-100.

Top spot goes to it since eight closed drawers let you separate stationery, cables and paperwork, which one-drawer carts cannot do. The tradeoff is the higher price bucket and no listed weight capacity.

It suits offices with many small supply categories. The caveat is missing size and capacity detail.
products.idealFor: Offices with many small supply categories.

products.name: Goovilla 3 Tier Rolling Utility Cart Organizer with Removable Drawer, Black
products.verdict: Tiers plus a removable drawer for under $25.
products.description:
The Goovilla is a 3-tier cart with a removable drawer and a 124 lb total capacity, in the under $25 bucket. Its tier count can be reconfigured from 3 to 5 layers, and it rolls on 360 degree swivel wheels with 2 lockable casters.

It ranks second because it gives some enclosed storage for the lowest price band, where the 8-drawer model costs more. The tradeoff is one drawer instead of eight.

It suits budget buyers who want flexibility. The caveat is a single drawer.

products.name: Goovilla Rolling Cart with 5 Drawers for Craft, Art, Dorm, Office, White
products.description:
This Goovilla is a rolling cart with 5 drawers in a white finish, priced $25-50, marketed for craft, art, dorm and office use.

Third place reflects a drawer count between the 8-drawer and 4-drawer carts, at a lower price than the 8-drawer. White is the distinguishing look.

It suits bright home offices. The caveat is that no capacity is listed.

products.name: Rolling Cart with Drawers, 4-Drawer Storage Cart on Wheels with Wooden Top, Metal
products.verdict: Four drawers with a usable wooden top.
products.description:
This cart has 4 drawers and a wooden top surface on a metal frame with wheels, priced $25-50.

Fourth place reflects fewer drawers than the 5 and 8 drawer carts, though the wooden top gives a surface for a printer or tray. That surface is the draw.

It suits buyers who want moderate organization and a working top. The caveat is thin spec detail.
products.idealFor: Buyers wanting a top work surface.

products.name: Pipishell 3 Tier Rolling Cart, Metal Utility Cart with Wheels and Handle
products.verdict: An open 3-tier cart with 22 lb per shelf.
products.description:
The Pipishell is a 3-tier open-shelf metal cart measuring 13.00 by 16.50 by 33.80 inches, rated 22 lb per shelf, with height-adjustable wheels. Four wheels are fitted, 2 of them lockable, priced $25-50.

It ranks fifth because open shelves offer no enclosed storage, unlike the drawer carts above. Its compact size is the upside.

It suits small spaces needing quick access. The caveat is the 22 lb per-shelf limit.

products.name: YASONIC 3 Tier Metal Rolling Cart, Black Utility Storage Cart with Wheels
products.verdict: Open tiers with hanging cups, hooks and a 110 lb rating.
products.description:
The YASONIC is a 3-tier open metal cart rated 110 lb, with 2 inch urethane wheels, 2 hanging cups and 3 hooks. Assembly takes about 15 minutes and it is priced $25-50.

It finishes last because it offers no drawers, but the hanging cups and hooks give it small-item storage that the Pipishell lacks. The tradeoff is open exposure.

It suits users who want fast access. The caveat is no enclosed storage.

whatMatters.detail: Drawers hide small items and separate categories, while open tiers keep things in view. Carts here run from 1 to 8 drawers. Check the drawer count in the title.
Capacity is how much the cart can hold, and some list a total while others list per shelf. A 22 lb per-shelf limit differs from 124 lb total. Look at which one the listing states.
Wheels make the cart portable, and locks keep it still while you work. Pipishell and Goovilla list lockable casters. Check how many wheels lock.
A flat top lets you use the cart as a small desk. The wooden top cart lists one. Look for top surface material.
A cart should fit beside your desk. Pipishell lists 13.00 by 16.50 by 33.80 inches. Measure your space against listed dimensions.

faq.q: How many drawers do I need?
faq.a: It depends on supply categories. The SYKIARIOL has 8 and the 4-drawer cart has 4.
Buying open shelves for small items. Drawers hide clutter better.

faq.q: Is the SYKIARIOL worth it over the Goovilla?
faq.a: If you have many categories, yes. The Goovilla 3-tier costs less.

faq.q: How do I assemble a cart?
faq.a: Follow the manual. The YASONIC lists about 15 minutes of assembly.

faq.q: How do I keep it from rolling?
faq.a: Use lockable casters. The Pipishell and Goovilla list them.

faq.q: Can I use it as a desk?
faq.a: The wooden top cart lists a top surface, but check its dimensions first.

finalTake: The SYKIARIOL 8-drawer cart is the best pick for offices with many small supplies. The Goovilla 3-tier is the budget hybrid, and the wooden top cart adds a work surface. Check drawer count and capacity before buying.
